description: This file defines the 'phy_tap' interface class for tapping into uplink symbols received by the PHY layer, allowing external processing and modification of resource grid symbols in a 5G/NR context.

classes.name: phy_tap
classes.description: Interface for external access to uplink symbols and resource grid in the PHY layer, enabling processing, modification, and observation of uplink data.

methods.name: handle_ul_symbol
methods.description: Handles each received uplink symbol, providing access to the resource grid and scheduled PDUs for potential modification.

methods.name: handle_quiet_grid
methods.description: Provides access to the complete resource grid for the last received uplink symbol without any associated request.
